defects.description: Code token `session_id` was translated to Russian and therefore does not match the required identifier.
Code token `phase_id` was changed to `фаза_id`, breaking the required identifier.
Field name `role_statuses` was altered to `Роль_statuses`, violating the required code token.
Field name `disagreement_subjects` was replaced with `Расхождение_subjects`, which is not the required identifier.
Field name `escalation_id` was translated to `эскалация_id`, breaking the required code token.
Field name `severity` was replaced with the Russian term `Уровень серьёзности`, which is not the required identifier.
Field name `resolution` was translated to `Резолюция`, violating the required code token.
Required field `reason` is missing from the EscalationRecord table.
The rule description “По одной на каждую активную роль; без пропусков” is placed under the `outcome` row instead of the `role_statuses` row.
defects.quote: По одной на каждую активную роль; без пропусков

defects.description: Stray Markdown code fence appears inside the table, breaking the document structure.
Inconsistent translation of `disagreement_subjects` description; uses “Темы” instead of the required “Объекты обсуждения”.
defects.quote: Темы, имеющие как `support`, так и `oppose` в финальном раунде
